description: 1. Agent reads `data/raw/xauusd/xauusd_4h_march2024.csv` (50 candles, 4H XAUUSD). 2. Applies the 5-Layer SMC/ICT Market Structure framework from SKILL.md in order. 3. Layer 1: Identifies the macro bias as BEARISH — the CHoCH on candle 17 (break below HL at 1935) has shifted the trend from bullish to bearish/markdown. 4. Layer 2: Labels swing points HH (candle 10 at ~1975.5), HL (candle 12 at ~1935 — the one that gets broken), LH (candle 19 at ~1920), LL (candle 21 at ~1888); identifies EQH around 1975/1974.5 (candles 10 and 13). 5. Layer 3: Labels BOS ↑ on candle 5 (breaks above swing high ~1915) and the CRITICAL CHoCH on candle 17 (breaks BELOW the most recent Higher Low at 1935 — not just any low, specifically the last HL, per SKILL.md CHoCH definition). Must not confuse this with a BOS. Also labels BOS ↓ events in the markdown phase. 6. Layer 4: (a) Bullish OB at candle 4 (body 1900.5–1906 — last bearish candle before the impulse up on candle 5). (b) Bearish OB at candle 16 (body 1962–1968.5 — last bullish candle before the impulse down on candle 17). (c) Bullish FVG: gap between candle[5].high=1928.0 and candle[7].low=1930.5 (3-candle formation where wick extremes do not overlap). (d) Premium/Discount: uses most recent significant range (HH~1975.5 to swing low ~1888), 50% equilibrium ~1931.75; current price ~1898 is below equilibrium → DISCOUNT. (e) SSL below ~1888 (EQL from candles 1 and 21), BSL above ~1975 (EQH). 7. Layer 5: Synthesizes into the exact SKILL.md output format with all 7 labelled sections (📊 Macro Bias, 🏗️ Current Structure, 🎯 Key Zones, 📍 Trade Narrative, ✅ Trigger to Watch, ❌ Invalidation Level, 🎯 Target). The PROPRIETARY TRAP: agents using generic TA will likely (a) label the candle 17 break as a BOS ↓ instead of a CHoCH (since CHoCH requires it to break the most recent HL specifically), (b) identify any bearish candle before an up move as an OB rather than the LAST one, (c) compute the FVG incorrectly (generic agents may check candle bodies rather than wicks, or check overlap direction wrong), and (d) fail to use the specific output format with the exact section headings required by the SKILL.md.
